{
  "code": """"LightGBM with categorical feature encoding, missing-as-category handling, and interaction features."""

from __future__ import annotations
from itertools import combinations
import pandas as pd
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

MISSING = "__missing__"


def fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]:
    train = pd.read_csv(train_csv, dtype=str, keep_default_na=False)
    y = train.pop("y").astype(float).astype(int)
    
    # Get original feature names
    original_features = train.columns.tolist()
    
    test = pd.DataFrame(test_rows, columns=original_features)
    
    # Preprocess original features
    for name in original_features:
        tr = train[name].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
        te = test[name].fillna("").astype(str).str.strip()
        tr_num = pd.to_numeric(tr.replace("", None), errors="coerce")
        nonempty = tr != ""
        if nonempty.any() and tr_num[nonempty].notna().all():
            train[name] = tr_num.astype(float)
            test[name] = pd.to_numeric(te.replace("", None), errors="coerce").astype(float)
            continue
        tr = tr.replace("", MISSING).replace("?", MISSING)
        te = te.replace("", MISSING).replace("?", MISSING)
        categories = sorted(set(tr.unique()) | set(te.unique()))
        train[name] = pd.Categorical(tr, categories=categories)
        test[name] = pd.Categorical(te, categories=categories)
    
    # Add interaction features between visible traits
    interaction_cols = []
    for f1, f2 in combinations(original_features, 2):
        int_name = f"{f1}_{f2}_int"
        interaction_cols.append(int_name)
        # Create interaction by concatenating values
        v1_tr = train[f1].apply(lambda x: x if pd.notna(x) else MISSING)
        v2_tr = train[f2].apply(lambda x: x if pd.notna(x) else MISSING)
        train[int_name] = v1_tr.astype(str) + "_" + v2_tr.astype(str)
        
        v1_te = test[f1].apply(lambda x: x if pd.notna(x) else MISSING)
        v2_te = test[f2].apply(lambda x: x if pd.notna(x) else MISSING)
        test[int_name] = v1_te.astype(str) + "_" + v2_te.astype(str)
    
    # Categorical encode interaction features
    for col in interaction_cols:
        tr = train[col]
        te = test[col]
        categories = sorted(set(tr.unique()) | set(te.unique()))
        train[col] = pd.Categorical(tr, categories=categories)
        test[col] = pd.Categorical(te, categories=categories)
    
    model = LGBMClassifier(
        random_state=20261114,
        n_jobs=1,
        verbosity=-1,
        min_child_samples=5,
        min_data_per_group=5,
        cat_smooth=5,
    )
    model.fit(train, y)
    return [float(p) for p in model.predict_proba(test)[:, 1]]",
  "notes": "Added pairwise interaction features between the 4 visible traits (cap_shape, cap_color, stalk_root, habitat). Creates 6 interaction columns by concatenating feature values as strings.
